newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish Ferrum steel mill delays share subscription.
newsitem.headline: Polish Ferrum steel mill delays share subscription.

text.p: Polish steel mill Ferrum SA postponed the subscription for its initial public offering to February 25 to March 3 from earlier announced February 11-17, the company said in a statement on Monday.
It said the dalay was caused by technical reasons, but did not elaborate.
It said it would offer 2.4 million shares in large investor tranche on February 25-26 and 600,000 shares in small investor tranche from February 26 to March 3.
Ferrum had a net profit of 3.2 million zlotys last year on 161.1-million-zloty sales.
It estimated its net to fall to 2.9 million zlotys in 1996 and to rebound to 3.3 million zlotys in 1997.
